learning_outcomes.text: Know and acquire the basics of linear algebra and analytical geometry, as well as the ability to understand more advanced topics in this area of mathematics to have the essential tools for basic scientific training and engineering applications.

Apply knowledge and understanding to the analysis and modeling of engineering problems, consciously using the acquired methods of linear algebra and analytical geometry. The ability to apply these methods is also acquired through the resolution of exercises that require the use of the acquired tools.
Set up and solve a problem using the logical-deductive method. These skills are fundamental in scientific and technological disciplines.
Improve their learning ability and autonomy of judgment.
Improve their communication skills thanks to the specificity of the language proper to basic subjects.

syllabus_topics: Space of mxn matrices: sum, product by scalars
Rank and linear independence of columns (rows) of a matrix
Basis of a vector space, coordinates and dimension
Vector subspaces of Rn: bases, dimension, parametric and Cartesian equations
Matrix associated with a linear application
Endomorphisms and changes of base: similar matrices
Algebraic and geometric multiplicity of an eigenvalue
assessment_rules: The assessment includes a written test and an oral test. The written test is a prerequisite for the oral test, requiring at least a passing grade. The overall grade, out of thirty, is given at the end of the oral examination, taking into account both tests. A minimum grade of eighteen/thirtieths is awarded for sufficient understanding and application of basic concepts. A maximum grade of thirty/thirtieths is achieved by demonstrating in-depth knowledge.
